page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 vCPUs mapped directly to 64 physical cores, operating at 1.0 thread per core with dedicated CPU allocation. This configuration ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times.

The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage operations must utilize network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No graphics processing units (GPUs) are present on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated core model with a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a dedicated general-purpose or compute-heavy resource. The absence of hyperthreading eliminates noisy-neighbor issues at the core level, which is beneficial for predictable execution but reduces the total concurrent thread count compared to hyperthreaded alternatives. This hardware profile is configured for workloads such as relational databases, enterprise applications, web serving, and distributed computing tasks that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
